description.text: This family contains the B domain of Staphylococcal protein A, which specifically binds to the Fc portion of immunoglobulin G.

wikipedia.title: SpAB_protein_domain
wikipedia.extract: In molecular biology, the domain B, refers to the immunoglobulin-binding domain found in the Staphylococcus aureus virulence factor protein A (SpA). Hence, it is abbreviated to SpAB.
